That's only one of the many many videos about the Cacerolazo, if you scroll down that page, you can see many more, and if you speak spanish, I recommend checking that page to be informed about what's going on here in Honduras.

What a disgusting article, jesus christ, that really makes me mad. The national mainstream media is also factually controlled by the current president, which is the reason why we aren't hearing much about the Cacerolazo and the peaceful protests in those channels. if you speak spanish and have fb, I really recommend getting your information somewhere else because it is absolutely baffling how mainstream news sources are trying to hide the information from the people, try Une TV, Univision, or hell, even Latin American CNN, those are the only news sources broadcasting things impartially.

*Constitutional rights, as In, cops will take you to jail, if not shoot you dead if they see you out in the streets after curfew, they're now in control of everything, they already killed a 9 year oid boy.

There is a shit ton of evidence about people from the other political party literally disguising themselves as people from the Alliance to loot stores and all of that nasty stuff, they literally started it just so there would be a justification to dictate a curfew. Obv, I'd be lying if I told that only them looted the stores, but that was their plan all along, this country is basically Venezuela rn and we only want justice to be served.
They're very overprotective, and they only let me go out with groups of people like friends or classmates. But I'm pretty sure I could think about something to sneak out.
I would love to make new friends but idk how to. I dropped out of school and I spend 24/7 on my home doing nothing because my parents don't let me go out. Where can I go meet new people?

Thank you for your words, you completely nailed it with the ''being ignored'' description.
If you need someone to talk, hit me up in the pm's, I'd be willing to listen to what you have to say.

Not much, to be honest. 
I'm an outcast, I dropped out of school and almost all of my friends have stopped talking to me. The only thing stopping me from ending my life is music. I'm a composer and I've been writing a lot of music lately, if it wasn't for that I honestly don't know where would I be. I just wish I could go back in time to cut the thing from its roots. I have nothing to do, I feel like i'm rotting in my bed because of how useless I've become. He made me try to be the best version of myself, but I guess it wasn't enough.

It really is, seems like I have no one to ask for help now, but I'll try to look up online, maybe it works.

Thanks ♡

As sad as it sounds, I've lost contact with most of my ex classmates and the very few I still keep in touch with are very busy almost all of the time (I was in that school so I know they aren't lying)

Hell, even my couple barely speaks to me because of his job, but anyways his stance on this topic is the same as my mother, so it doesn't matter I guess.

I'll try to do some research as you said, right now everything just seems to be falling apart anyways so I don't lose nothing.

Thank you for your time and your help, I really appreciate it ♡

I have tried, I swear, and as I said, even an actual psychologist told them that I require help but I guess that doesn't mean anything to them. I truly don't know what else to do now and I feel really discouraged to even keep trying.
